scope: Freeze the current runtime and evaluate new MPS speakers without tuning.

selection.selection_rule: Two paired-paragraph speakers per grade/gender stratum, sorted pools and fixed RNG seed; shuffle all 24 recordings once. No selection by duration, transcript quality, miscues, audio or ASR outcome.

unrelated_controls.kind: Saved callbacks, not fresh audio trials

limitations: New speakers on six familiar MPS passages, not unseen books or Southeast Asian readers.
Provider word labels are review evidence, not independent human listening acceptance or timing gold.
No microphone/room or human-verified word-end-to-effect latency claim.

review_flags: Provider reports anchor substitutions/deletions; pronunciation acceptance unresolved
